svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: any open source? Port Visualizer, MIT-licensed: a Windows desktop app for inspecting and managing active TCP/UDP ports. Live connection diffing, process-grouped views and safe process termination, with UAC elevation and core system processes protected Queries the native PowerShell API and falls back to netstat parsing when security policy blocks it CI runs lint, type-check, unit tests, build and installer packaging on every push Q: wait, Sand worked at embassies? Three of them, in the federal sector since 2021: 2023-now Panama Access Control Coordinator, Regional Security Office 2022-23 Cyprus Consular Associate, U.S. Embassy Nicosia 2021 Honduras Administrative Assistant, Community Liaison Office Along the way: p…
